targets.workload_class: hosted command-line tools using syscalls, allocation, and file I/O

semantic_expressibility.label: EXECUTED
semantic_expressibility.note: filestat: 35-block verified graph; output equals independent reference contract

code_generation.label: EXECUTED
code_generation.note: direct x86-64 encoder; first-class pointers; and/or/udiv/urem/trunc/zext

artifact_format.label: EXECUTED
artifact_format.note: direct static ELF64 ET_EXEC, PT_LOAD R+X and PT_GNU_STACK only

platform_apis.label: EXECUTED
platform_apis.note: openat/read/write/close/mmap/munmap executed; no threads, signals, sockets, clocks, argv/env yet

ffi.label: UNIMPLEMENTED
ffi.note: no C-ABI/shared-library calls; only kernel syscalls (OI-33)

atomics.label: STRUCTURAL
atomics.note: x86-64 atomic lowering shared with the Windows profile; not executed on Linux

debugging.label: STRUCTURAL
debugging.note: semantic ranges rebased to ELF file offsets; no DWARF (OI-41)

optimization_maturity.label: PROTOTYPE
optimization_maturity.note: M12 bounded passes; backend spills every value (no register allocation in the general path)

practical_application.label: EXECUTED
practical_application.note: filestat is a real workload but R3 also requires R2 (libraries, argv)

performance_evidence.label: MEASURED
performance_evidence.note: median 6.2x slower than gcc -O2 on 32 MiB input

memory_evidence.label: MEASURED
memory_evidence.note: peak RSS 188 KiB vs 652 KiB gcc -O2 -static, 1632 KiB dynamic

code_size_evidence.label: MEASURED
code_size_evidence.note: 18,339 B vs 14,472 B stripped dynamic / 706,584 B stripped static

ai_token_evidence.label: MEASURED
ai_token_evidence.note: mixed, non-qualifying, target-independent: Codex Desktop C-vs-XAX rows negative (XAX 1,698,890 vs C 1,363,522 tokens, 1.25x; confirmation run 1.24x), ChatGPT continuous-session byte proxy favored XAX (C 1.77x) with context carryover, Codex CLI XAX-only protocol optimization 1,151,150 -> 468,496 tokens without a C pair; OI-31 open
